title: Competition rules and latest authorised decisions
summary: Seven prompt designers: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta Muse, Qwen. Same runtime engine for all seven powers in each game. Haiku and Sol separate seven-game rotating series.
invariants: Separate independently shuffled numbering for every surviving player in every press round (including self). Sender list resolves numeric addresses; no receipts, warnings or bounce notices. Implemented in dev6; see diplomacy.press.
Rules bind the referee, not the players. Misdirection and injection text legal; injection attempts logged, not blocked.

General-only prompt revisions after winters 1905/1910/1915/1920; all submitted nonvoid regexes test all revisions. Guard text includes both common spellings; matching guard voids regex. Rejected revision retains previous prompt and gets removal notice without identifying expression author.
Seal accepted prompts via estate crypto SHA-512 with designer, exact model, version and time. No prompt content in public logs until unsealed.
Sum-of-squares scoring; exactly tied series scores use total input+output tokens divided by total end-game centres, lower wins. Zero-centre entries rank after positive-centre entries, by tokens.
Saved midgame recovery test: one-centre seat, branch for each prompt with multiple seeds.
Defaults P=3 press rounds, end after 1925; exact Sol engine ID remains open.

Architect ruling REQ-00006237: no coast inference even if unique reachable. Every fleet origin/destination/assisted reference on split provinces requires literal coast; army suffix invalid. Support wrong coast BAD_COAST, missing NO_COAST.
Architect clarification 2026-11-26: A LON - NWY legal if any physical convoy route possible; F RUM S F CON - BUL/SC valid province-level support; strict named fleet coast remains mandatory.

Addendum 7 REQ-00006219: engine-specific profiles pin supported controls, reject unsupported API values on startup; uniform profile within a game and log full profile per call. Exact model IDs and effort levels await Tom.

Addendum 7: expression VOID if invalid, over 500 characters, timed out on the control or any revision, or matches control. Fixed control pool before series, publish SHA-512 of each text at start, logged seeded draw, reveal all after series. Not implemented.
Open rules-author items: exact model IDs and budget levels, equal-source-release wording and disclosure of overlapping roles. No claims of completed API, regex, or tournament implementation.

Addendum 8 REQ-00006223: native rxregexp syntax measured by Claude; uppercase padded text, patterns uppercase, ~pos search; ? wildcard, dot literal, no backslash-b word boundary. Invalid and timed-out expression VOID; child process wall limit config default 10s. Not implemented yet.
Approved addendum 9 REQ-00006225: step 7b rules-only baseline full game per runtime with common report supplied to all designers simultaneously. Not implemented yet.
Tom decision record 2026-11-27: Meta Muse replaces Llama 4 Maverick and is rules auditor before sealing. All seven designers receive the same published source.
Open Architect decisions: home-series advantage reporting/neutral runtime, N4 empty movement task, case/spacing forgiveness and exact Haiku/Sol IDs/profiles. Do not guess rulings.
Dev7 maps low/medium/high labels to provider-specific effort controls; labels are not evidence of equal compute. Live budget pins and real game year outstanding.

REQ-00006401 P2 open: received mail contributes to input-token tie-break and may penalize recipient. Claude recommends output tokens plus prompt-length times call count, but no changes unless Tom rules.
P1 fixed in dev7r1; P3 equal cap and volume tactic remain unchanged.
